description: Creates a copy of a Google Drive file or document

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

fileId.description: ID of the file to copy

newName.description: Name for the copied file. If not provided, will use 'Copy of [original name]'

parentFolderId.description: ID or path of the destination folder (defaults to same folder as original)

name: copyFile
